adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Post.cook_method == :raw_html` which makes `Post#cook` return `raw` directly (app/models/post.rb), bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/topic_embed.rb), and the spec asserts `post.cooked == post.raw`, confirming cooked can contain arbitrary HTML. The embed view then renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), which will output that HTML unescaped inside a Discourse-origin iframe, creating an XSS risk if imported/feed content contains unsafe markup.
